_notes: Model names and hosts are placeholders. Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint works, including a LiteLLM proxy.
keyEnv names an environment variable; keys never go into this file or the browser.
policy: manual = first candidate until /model switches; fallback = next candidate on error or timeout.
title with no candidates means the index uses each message's first sentence.

local: true marks a candidate that runs on your own machine or network. After a local candidate fails, fallback never goes to a non-local one unless the role sets allowCloudFallback: true. Missing local counts as non-local.
/model <role> <name> pins the role (no fallback) until /model <role> auto.
stallMs: once a reply has started, abort it when no new token arrives for this long (default 20000).

experiments (pilot-v0.9): settledInput false = Enter only (the default, D9). true = after settleMs (default 1800) of no typing on an input that looks finished, the page offers "send?" (Tab sends, Enter always sends). /flag settled-input on|off overrides it in .pilot/flags.json.

frame (pilot-v0.10): the role behind the frame-proposals experiment. It only proposes a FrameIntent (schemas/frame-intent.schema.json); it is called only while experiments.frameProposals is true or /flag frame-proposals on (default off), and follows pins, local-only fallback and stallMs like every role.
